summary.answer: Locks input and marks UI active for every controller, starts video-event setup and builds main menu. It tracks reload-close children, closes them before reload setup, builds toast/spinner/optional warning/free cursor/overlay, polls UI3D readiness and cancels that timer when ready. Music subscription removes the previous subscription, replaces/closes delay timers, and plays only a nonempty state name. Debug reload clears children then rebuilds. Its close hook references element.toastNotification although the local toast is not assigned to that field in the selected text; preserve this external/fidelity assumption.
